author: bardic-inspiration
name: Sunken Cistern
summary: A flooded cistern of five rooms under an old mill.
description: The mill's cistern flooded when its sluice rusted shut. Something has nested in the shrine at its heart.

zones.name: Sluice Gate
zones.note: The way in, down a ladder beside the rusted gate.

zones.name: Flooded Hall
zones.note: Knee-deep water hides the broken floor.

zones.name: Overflow
zones.note: A narrow tunnel back to the river.
